mission.title: Industrial Sabotage
mission.description: Find the missing Zion informant Frog.

npc.say: Where are you going? No... No, don't leave me alone with him! Hey!
Looking for a hot tip? Me too. But this place seems pretty dead.

Ha! I thought so! You'd better get over to that facility, operative; maybe you'll still be in time to stop the Exiles from trashing the insecticide and flit guns there. Don't worry about me. Rat and I have a lot of...catching up to do.

phase.briefing: The Merovingian has been attacking our operations with renewed vigor; intel suggests that he's alarmed by our acquisition of flit guns capable of hurting his Assassin. One of our most vital informants, Frog, has suddenly gone missing, and we suspect Exile involvement. You've been tapped to recover him. Start by checking his usual base of operations for clues.

enter.say: That's the place where Frog used to hang. Look around and see if you can find anything.

The computer in that room is active and password-protected. Maybe Frog left some sort of clue on it. If you can't break the security yourself, search around: he may have written his password down somewhere.

objective.text: Find a clue to Frog's whereabouts

done.say: Nice. Now search it for any useful information.

That file has a recent timestamp. Could Frog have been investigating an Exile plan to attack one of our facilities? Maybe the Exiles found out he was snooping and decided to shut him up. Let's see what Anome thinks of this.

phase.briefing: Huh, sounds like you may be onto something. We don't have any data on the location specified in that file you found. If Frog went there on his own, he could very well have run into trouble. I want you to go investigate the place and see if you can find the Exile named "Rat"; maybe he knows something.

enter.say: My screen's showing a number of signals inside, both Exiles and redpills. I hope this isn't a trap.

talk.say: Well, well; I do believe we've found our Exile.
Frog? Yeah, maybe I know 'im, and maybe I don't. What's it worth to ya?
Huh, he may be willing to talk. The next room appears to be empty; take him in there and see if you can "persuade" him to tell us what he knows about Frog.
Sure, let's go somewhere nice and quiet where we can negotiate.

Ow, ow! Okay, okay, I'll talk! We figured Frog was being a bit too nosy, so we decided to keep him out of trouble back at our HQ. Whoa, easy! L-look, I'll take you to him, okay? Just don't hurt me! I'd like to keep this shell in one piece.
Nice. Lead him out of there and let's see where he takes us.

objective.text: Lead Rat out of the area

phase.briefing: What a mewling, pathetic excuse for a program! No wonder he's an Exile--couldn't hack it in Machine City. It's almost a pity that we need him alive; I'd like to see what he'd do if his "shell" were cracked. Go where he directs you, operative. If Rat's an example of the gang we're dealing with, Frog might even still be alive.

enter.say: There's some kind of shielding on that place; I can't get a long-range scan. I'll have to depend on data relayed from your RSI.

talk.say: You're from Zion? Wow, that's fabulous. Look, take out the rest of the Exiles around here, then we'll talk. Oh hey, I'll need to talk to that Rat fellow, too.
You heard the man: take out all the Exiles in the area!

done.say: That's all of them. Now let's see what Frog has for us.

talk.say: Hey, do you have that bottom-feeder, Rat, with you? Let me talk to him for a sec. I've got a question that I'm sure he's just dying to answer for me.

done.say: Okay, okay! Just keep Frog away from me! The rest of the crew has gone to take out the Zion manufacturing facility near here. Something about stealing their bug spray guns, I think. Look, that's all I know, I swear!
So they really are after the manufacturing facility! This could be bad. Head outside while I check in with Anome.
Rat! I oughta gut you! Where are the rest of your buddies?

phase.briefing: The manufacturing facility! Crap! Most of our new flit guns and insecticide stores are in there! Why does this kind of thing always happen to me? I'm routing you over to the facility, {player}; you're the only resource I have that can get there in time. You've got to exterminate those Exiles before they trash the place!

enter.say: I'm scanning a ton of Exile signals in there. Looks like you're in for a real rumble.

objective.text: Kill the Exiles in the facility

mission.finish: Nice job. It looks like the Merovingian is making a concerted effort to protect the Assassin by taking away our weapons. Maybe this latest episode will convince the Council that we have to take the fight to him; if it was up to me, that martini-sucking pervert of a program would have been ground up into French mystery-meat a long time ago.
